tasks.title: Launch Clarity v1.0 to the public
tasks.description: Package the app for distribution, set up a landing page, and share it with the first group of users. This is the big one.
tasks.deliverable: Public download link live, at least 10 people using the app
tasks.notes: Need to finalize installer signing and write the landing page copy. Designer friend offered to help with the hero image.

tasks.title: Weekly review and planning session
tasks.description: Every Monday morning: review what got done last week, check deadlines coming up, and decide the top 3 priorities for the week.
tasks.deliverable: Updated task list with this week's top 3 priorities set
tasks.notes: Block 8-9am. No emails before this is done.

subtasks.title: Set top 3 priorities for the week

tasks.title: Build the Clarity landing page
tasks.description: A clean one-page site explaining what Clarity does, showing screenshots, and linking to the download. Should work on mobile too.
tasks.deliverable: Live URL with download button and at least one screenshot
tasks.notes: Keep it simple — hero, 3 feature highlights, download button. Can use Vercel for free hosting.

subtasks.title: Take 3 good screenshots of the app

tasks.title: Learn and practice color grading in DaVinci Resolve
tasks.description: Work through the free DaVinci Resolve course on YouTube. Focus on the color grading module — primary corrections, secondaries, and node-based workflow.
tasks.deliverable: One short film fully color graded from scratch
tasks.notes: Already have the footage from March shoot. Using it as practice material.

tasks.title: Daily journaling
tasks.description: Write for 10 minutes every morning. Can be anything — thoughts, plans, gratitude, observations. No structure required.
tasks.notes: First thing after coffee, before checking phone.

tasks.title: Research and choose a code signing certificate for Windows
tasks.description: Windows SmartScreen blocks unsigned .exe installers with scary warnings. Need to get a code signing cert so Clarity installs cleanly for new users.
tasks.deliverable: Certificate purchased and configured in electron-builder
tasks.notes: Sectigo OV certs seem like the best value. EV cert costs ~$300/year but removes SmartScreen entirely — worth it if we get serious traction.

subtasks.title: Purchase and configure in build pipeline

tasks.title: Write the first Clarity changelog / release post
tasks.description: Document what's in v1.0, what problems it solves, and what's coming next. This doubles as marketing content and a communication to early users.
tasks.deliverable: Published post on a blog or Substack with at least 300 words
tasks.notes: Keep it personal — this is a tool I built for myself that might help others. Not a corporate launch post.

tasks.title: Monthly finances review
tasks.description: Go through last month's spending, check savings progress, update the budget spreadsheet, and flag anything unexpected.
tasks.deliverable: Spreadsheet updated, any surprises noted and addressed
tasks.notes: Do this on the 1st of every month without fail.
